This is the same jointguideline as7.3.1 andKeyPerspectives, not a second independent source. Fullarticle not attested.

source_reads.support: Intervention for rupture; endovascular preferred over open in suitable anatomy.

Summary only; full guideline was not attested read. Joint2022 ACC/AHA guideline; part1, part2 and guideline physical-activity extract are one editorial group.

source_reads.support: Duration, entry, size, segmental extent, clinical complications and false-lumen features guide decisions.
source_reads.read_scope: Retrieved original-publication indexed text of9.3.1 classification and therapeutic intervention including complicated typeB and rupture; direct open failed, no claim of full guideline reading.

evidence_notes: Guidelines and MSD share registry/upstream evidence. Independent editorial source groups are not independent clinical trials. No universal survival percentage, outpatient observation for rupture, or single repair technique is asserted; concrete anatomy and stability conditions retained.

candidate_codes.rationale: Explicit rupture and extent branches cover ascending disease with/without arch extension and descending disease with rupture; the residual described descending pattern receives an anatomy/complication-based decision branch. Existing14 sections provide applicable emergency actions, recovery, medication, diet, surveillance and prevention, without implying all anatomies have identical procedures. Source-defined intramural haematoma/penetrating ulcer remain distinct; not used to expand unrelated ICD categories.
